# The first bowl cracks at the foot

The bowl survived firing and cracked while cooling. Nessa says the base was thick enough to stay warm after the rim had cooled. I was proud of making it sturdy. Next time trim the foot before deciding whether it feels secure in the hand. Took a photograph of the broken edge, which shows more of the process than the finished bowl would have. [[Pottery]] is becoming an archive of mistakes.
